title: Payment API returning 503 errors
description: Multiple customers reported 503 responses from the Payments API.
root_cause: The payment service exceeded its connection pool capacity during a traffic spike.
resolution: Increased connection pool capacity and restarted affected service instances.

title: Analytics dashboard slow
description: Dashboard queries became increasingly slow after a large increase in stored events.
root_cause: A frequently used analytics query was missing an appropriate database index.
resolution: Added the required database index and optimized the query.

title: Password reset emails missing
description: Password reset requests succeeded but customers did not receive emails.
root_cause: The outbound email provider rejected messages because the sending domain configuration was invalid.
resolution: Corrected the domain authentication configuration and verified email delivery.

title: Delayed webhook delivery
description: Webhook events accumulated in the delivery queue and were processed several minutes late.
root_cause: The webhook worker queue became saturated during a large event burst.
resolution: Scaled the webhook workers and processed the queued events.

title: Intermittent database connection failures
description: Application instances periodically failed to connect to the database.
root_cause: The database reached its maximum connection limit.
resolution: Increased the database connection limit and reduced unnecessary persistent connections.
